themes.name: Amber Signal
themes.description: Tokyo pre-dawn: warm amber vending machine glow against deep indigo, sharp poster geometry softened by atmospheric stillness.

props.text: 4:47am. The vending machine doesn't sleep. Its amber hum carves geometry into the indigo dark — a still life of signal and silence before the city remembers itself.

themes.name: Botanical Sérigraphie
themes.description: Art Nouveau's botanical obsession filtered through dawn's pale awakening — silkscreen-flat cards, jewel-toned botanical accents, and an organic scattered rhythm.

props.text: Pressed petals under silkscreen ink. Dawn light through a greenhouse pane. Every card a herbarium specimen — flat, jewelled, alive.

themes.name: Arroyo Ledger
themes.description: Dawn light catching the adobe wall — terracotta dust, ochre shadow, and the precise geometry of a surveyor's field index.

themes.name: Misty Aperture
themes.description: A Swiss-grid gallery at first light — cool mist over warm linen, where generous negative space and a single teal accent do the quiet work of a whole orchestra.

props.text: First light through frosted glass. One teal note sustains where lesser palettes would crowd the silence.
